title: spec: dataset vocabulary keys (synonyms, member description) and dataset tool I/O schemas (ADR-0149 D1/D2)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ② a child card of an Accepted ADR. [ADR-0149](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md) D7 card 1, with card 4 folded in: the seat takes up the record's offer ("may merge into card 1 if the seat prefers one spec PR"), so the vocabulary keys and the tool I/O schemas ship as one spec contract. Parent: #31503, landed by PR #31535.
Reader: the `domain:spec` lane. Seat suggests p1, because this is a protocol addition and cards 2 and 3 wait on it.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "dataset synonyms description measure dimension" and "dataset-tools.zod" found nothing besides #31503.
Rulings: 田騏 2026-11-08 on cloud#3825 待裁 2 「同意放 objectstack」 and on the forks 「同意」 (M1 A, M2 A, M3 A), recorded verbatim in the ADR's Status and Decided by.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** ADR-0149 已定：数据集的指标和维度要加 `synonyms`（同义词）和 `description`（人话写的业务定义）。两个数据集工具的输入输出也要在 spec 里定形。
- **影响面：** spec 新增可写键和一份工具 I/O schema，属于协议新增。卡 2（service-analytics 工具）和卡 3（MCP 注册）都等这张卡。
- **需要您做的：** 无，由 spec 车道实现，按惯例评审。

## Task (quote the D-sections; the ADR is the contract)

- [ ] **D1:** `synonyms: string[]` and member `description: I18nLabel` on `DatasetMeasureSchema` / `DatasetDimensionSchema`, plus the aliases D1 lists.
  - Uniqueness is validated at dataset level.
  - Add translation-group keys, and keep the `ui/` mirrors in step.
  - Add liveness rows, and regenerate the schema and docs.
- [ ] **M1 A:** `description` is a business definition in plain words, not a prompt; no AI-steering text enters spec. Retire the two `description` guidance entries and `DATASET_MEMBER_NO_DESCRIPTION`.
- [ ] **D2, from card 4:** `ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` holds the inputs and outputs of `list_datasets` / `query_dataset`, including `provenance`, projected to JSON Schema.
- [ ] **D6 (enforce-or-remove):** each new key names its reader in this card's PR. The reader is the card 2 executor, so state the reader and the follow-up explicitly.

Declare `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` on the PR. A spec change needs a Fable review.
